definition.description: NOAA daily station weather woven into an interactive year-long SVG tapestry. Temperature colors the threads, precipitation bends them, and wind adds texture. Edit station/year and run to refresh.

Months run downward; day of month runs left to right. Wet days bend the threads; wind adds cross-stitches. Gray crosshatching marks an absent day or a missing color measurement. Incomplete precipitation flags are not treated as dry weather.

Daily sample

Choose a day in the weave or use Inspect date.
Source: NOAA NCEI Global Summary of the Day. Daily summaries use GMT/UTC, not the browser's timezone. Station observations do not represent an entire city. Precipitation reporting intervals may overlap the previous day; flags and gaps matter. This is a descriptive artwork, not a forecast, climate trend, or certified annual total. Controls change this snapshot only; changing station/year requires editing the graph configuration and running again.

template.summary: A weather-history textile using real station observations, with explicit gaps and reporting flags.
